title: My time
sub: Your recorded working time. Every change is logged and visible to you.
break_warning_help: Legal minimum breaks: 15 min after 5.5 h, 30 min after 7 h, 60 min after 9 h.
entries_hint: Click an entry to change it
reason_today_help: Changes to today's entries don't need a reason.
reason_past_help: Required for past days. Shown in the change history.
reason_other_help: Required. The employee is notified and sees your reason.
was_corrected: This entry was changed by someone else. Open the history to see what changed or to dispute it.
history_sub: Every change to this entry, who made it and why.
locked_banner: {month} was signed off by {name} on {date}. Entries in this month can no longer be changed. An administrator can reopen the month if needed.
locked_editor: This month was signed off by {name} on {date} and is read-only. Ask an administrator to reopen it if something needs to be corrected.
reason_needed_self: This entry is on a past day. Please explain the change in the 'Reason' field below; it is stored in the change history.
reason_needed_other: You are changing the time of {name}. Please explain the change below; {name} will be notified and sees your reason.
reason_missing: Please enter a reason before saving.
